proposed_facts.reason: Independently verified every cited range. The header declares the three-argument function and matching item-local typedef; the class setup slot uses that typedef and initialization casts to it. The complete callback reads neither integer argument and obtains render mode from mobj->rendermode. This useful correction agrees with functionality.md while appropriately deferring universal generic-dispatch ABI conclusions.

contradictions.reason: The callback explanation omission is resolved by proposal fact 0. The local three-argument declaration is explicit; broader dispatch ABI uncertainty is accepted rather than inferred away.

Accept the deferrals for the five .data-related facts and both section-related links. Class registration, reusable templates and their rendering consumption are supported source behavior, which is retained. Neither source declarations nor offset comments establish compiled section membership or layout. The initializer also contains no local once guard, so global exactly-once initialization remains unverified.

Accept all four .sdata-related fact deferrals. The cited failure paths demonstrate diagnostics and assertions, not the filename's compiled storage, exact 16-byte extent, spelling, terminator, padding or complete access set. No compiled evidence was supplied, and analogy with another translation unit cannot resolve those claims.

unresolved: Compiled section identities, offsets, extents, string placement and padding remain unverified; the section-related upstream deferrals are accepted.
The item-local callback signature does not establish the trailing-argument ABI at every generic dispatch site.
Global exactly-once initialization is not established by the initializer body.
Numeric item flags and PE settings retain their concrete behavior without unsupported gameplay labels.
The header shadowed_binding diagnostic remains a rendering issue.
Acceptance covers the verified proposal and examined contradictions. Unchanged retained research rows are inherited verbatim, not represented as a new independent audit.
